summary_text: Q1 2026: revenues RMB 7.5B (+7% YoY), gross profit +9% YoY, gross margin 37.1% (15th consecutive qtr of margin expansion). Advertising revenue +30% YoY (13th consecutive qtr double-digit). DAU 115M (+8%), MAU 376M. Creators >1000 followers +30% YoY, avg income per creator +24%. Key catalyst: sustaining margin improvement without sacrificing growth. Risk: rising content/creator costs outpacing revenue. Stock had been sinking ahead of earnings.
